content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am looking to set up a web server on a [product_name] with [version_no]. Could someone assist me? Thanks.
To enable the web server, go to Tools > Transfer > Access Control and activate web server access. See the attached file for reference.
Thank you. Is it possible to control the [product_name] using a mobile phone or Android device?

Search online for apps such as [product_name] App [version_no] or S7Droid App. I'm not certain if the S7 Android app is compatible with the [product_name] [article_no].
Could you share the software or provide a download link?
Download information for the [product_name] App can be found here: [url]
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate discussion titled, 'Possible to control [product_name] [version_no] from mobile by Webserver or App?'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking help to activate and use the web server feature on a [product_name] controller, focusing on [version_no], and wants to access it remotely using mobile devices. Community members provided guidance on configuring web server access through the software, suggested relevant mobile apps, and discussed compatibility concerns related to third-party apps for mobile integration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple method to activate the web server and reliable remote control of the PLC via mobile devices, ideally through an easy setup and compatible mobile applications.
